nome: inemaSEO 2 — Content: pages only you can write

lado_card.texto: With your pages live, course 3 teaches you to measure: separate the brand, read URL Inspection, and turn impressions without clicks into a content plan.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/inemaseo · inemaSEO method (MIT) · inema.club

inicio.titulo: Content: pages only you can write
inicio.lead: With the groundwork in place, what decides things is the content. Not what any AI writes on its own, but what only you know: who is behind the site, your first-hand data, your experience. In eight lessons you declare your entity, separate territories, validate your content plan for free, write pillar pages and listing pages with real data, link everything together, and learn what not to do.
inicio.capa_alt: The owner of a small artisan bakery writes in a notebook next to the laptop, at the wooden counter.

numeros.t: items on the checklist before publishing

inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of the work: say who you are, decide where each thing lives, choose the content plan, write, link, and protect yourself from shortcuts.

itens: Site owners or creators who already did the foundation (course 1): verified site, one canonical only, sitemap and robots.txt decided.
People who publish but don't show up in searches by people who don't know the brand yet.
People being invited to "publish 500 articles with AI" who want to know why that goes wrong.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Declare author and brand with a fixed @id, so Google and AIs know who is behind the site.
Give each search intent an owner page and validate your content plan without a paid tool.
Write pillar pages, question pages, listing pages, and news only with real data, with an anti-fabrication check.
Link your pages together and run each one through the 16-item checklist before publishing.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation: the technical groundwork, which this course assumes is ready.
2 Content (this course) and 3 Measurement: the pages only you can write and the number that matters, searches that don't include your brand.
4 In AIs, 5 With Agents, and 6 Professional: official AI dashboards, agents doing the repetitive work, and SEO as a service.
7 Systems: the 5 open tools of inemaseo-sistemas, your own open Semrush.
All of them follow the inemaSEO method, open (MIT), applied on the INEMA portal, news site, and events site.
